tools.name: convert_pdf_url
tools.description: Convert a PDF available at a public HTTP or HTTPS link into Markdown for reading, research or a coding project. Returns extracted text, page and table counts, and whether scanned pages were found. No OCR, private links or local files. The reply is limited to 20,000 Markdown characters and marks long

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "convert_pdf_url" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Convert a PDF available at a public HTTP or HTTPS link into Markdown for reading, research or a coding project. remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
